text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—...I see. Rather than relying on a single checklist,
you prepare multiple patterns to accommodate all possible scenarios.
choice_data_list: At the same time, I try not to get too bound by the sheets.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Meaning it is strictly one tool among many for management.
I shall follow your example and keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of which, regarding this self-check item for the lower limbs,
may I ask a question—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The reason I am having this "study session" with Ikuno Dictus right now
traces back to our conversation the other day—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case... If I may take advantage of your generosity,
there is a small request I would like to make—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Would you be willing to share your knowledge with me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—When you recommended an examination the other day,
I secretly admired your meticulous perspective regarding horsegirls.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From your conduct, I sensed an unshakeable conviction:
the desire to keep horsegirls running healthy and long into the future.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Simultaneously, I felt a strong desire to learn from your knowledge,
which led me to make this proposal. ...What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After readily accepting Ikuno Dictus's proposal,
I decided to hold regular study sessions with her to share knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I taught her various things: details for self-check sheets,
self-massage techniques, dietary recipes suited for her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And right now, using a corner of the cafeteria,
I am teaching her how to make smoothies.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...! This is delicious...!
The fruit flavor is refreshing, and the texture is remarkably smooth—
choice_data_list: It's especially recommended right after training.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Beyond its exceptional taste, using common ingredients is fantastic.
It can be implemented immediately, which I deeply appreciate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus's thirst for knowledge and sharp comprehension
are truly something to behold...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I became curious about how she acquired
this diligence and extraordinary capacity for self-management—
choice_data_list: Mind if I ask something while we take a break?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. What is it?
choice_data_list: Is your method of self-management... self-taught?
Is your method of self-management... self-taught?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No. There was someone who taught me the fundamentals.
A mentor to whom I owe a great debt... before enrolling in the academy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Meeting that person was purely by chance.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—A long time ago, I had a sports bicycle that I considered my "partner."
...It was a precious bike given to me by my parents.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Cutting through the wind alongside my partner was sheer bliss...
I would often ride far into the distance, completely losing track of time.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...However, one day, I had a falling accident,
and my precious partner was broken—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My partner, which had ridden with such vitality, ceased moving in an instant...
I simply stood there, frozen... and in that moment, a thought occurred to me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Objects... lives... once broken like this...
can never run again...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Unable to suppress the cold dread welling up from within,
I could do nothing but stare blankly at my broken partner—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text: "—Hey there, are you all right?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The one who called out to me then was Sensei...—
My mentor.

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text: "Um... Can it really... be fixed...?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me. This kind of maintenance is a hobby of mine.
It took quite a beating, but replace a few parts and—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Sensei operated a chiropractic clinic primarily for racing horsegirls,
and maintained sports gear and bicycles as a hobby.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"—Ikuno-kun, was it? We've got a plan to fix your bike,
yet you look rather downcast. Are you still hurting anywhere?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I told him.
About that cold sensation I felt the moment my partner broke.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Sensei listened quietly while working on my bike.
...To the vague, inexplicable fear that my young self could barely put into words—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"—It's true that things break. We get injured too.
However... that doesn't mean it's an immediate end."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"Objects, living beings—so long as they exist, they can always get back on their feet.
...Just like this partner of yours."

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text: "Wah...! Amazing! It really is... all fixed...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"...Ikuno-kun. I want you to remember this well. When something is damaged or broken,
repairing it like this will ensure it can always move forward again."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"This is what we call 'maintenance.'
It is the technique that allows us to stand back up, no matter the hardships we encounter."

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text: "Maintenance..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text: "And there is another vital skill that goes hand-in-hand with maintenance."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text: "The skill of managing yourself and your surroundings, anticipating difficulties before they occur, avoiding breakdowns and injury, and steadily walking toward your dreams and goals—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text: "Namely, 'management.'"

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text:
"...If we have that maintenance and management...
can we... stay healthy and strong forever?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, precisely. ...What do you say, Ikuno-kun?
Would you like to learn the methods to combat the anxieties you harbor?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—And so, learning management and maintenance from my teacher,
I succeeded in dispelling the anxieties that had once troubled me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, this management and maintenance could be applied not only
to servicing my partner, but to my own running as well—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—And as I experienced the genuine joy of running with the wind against me,
a certain feeling began welling up from within.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"How far can I truly run?"
...And so, I wanted to prove it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That by utilizing the management and maintenance taught to me by Sensei,
I could surely... go anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —To continue running longer than anyone else, and to accumulate more victories than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is the ultimate "goal" I have calculated—
one that will prove both my racing capabilities and Sensei's teachings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a grand objective that seemed almost contradictory to her steadfast, pragmatic nature.
Yet the light in Ikuno Dictus's eyes as she spoke was... unwavering and firm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it were her, she could undoubtedly achieve that goal.
And what is more... it resonated deeply with the oath I carried in my own heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is why—
as a Trainer, I want to help Ikuno Dictus...!役
choice_data_list: —Let me help you achieve that goal.
—Please let me help you achieve that goal.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: By that, you mean—
choice_data_list: I want to be your Trainer.
I want to be your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...................
I am truly honored by your offer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However—I must respectfully decline.
